payload.objective: Evaluate next unit in dependency graph (M2.7) following M2.6 checkpoint completion and issue initial TASK_DISPATCH with strict design-system (<x-layouts.workspace-layout>, <x-layouts.report-layout>) and sub-500-line decomposition constraints.
payload.explicit_request: Unit M2.6 is COMPLETED and checkpointed (commit 1bd25cef, control-plane commit 504c30f1). Role dashboards feature (M9.1-M9.4) is registered. Please issue the formal TASK_DISPATCH for M2.7 (read-only analysis).

payload.reason: M2.6 is checkpointed and its dependency is satisfied. M2.7 is the next critical unit and is authorized to enter read-only analysis. The analysis must establish legacy Drawing Hall workspace and four statutory print-template parity, identify reusable CampusLynk shells/components, map decomposition boundaries, and surface risks before any implementation is authorized.

task_dispatch.objective: Perform a read-only forensic analysis of the R21 Drawing Hall workspace and its four statutory print outputs, determine the complete functional and visual migration scope, and recommend the first concrete implementation slice.
instructions: Inspect the legacy R21 Drawing Hall workspace view and all four statutory print views/templates.
Inspect the existing M2.6 Drawing Hall controller, routes, models, and relevant target-side data structures to establish backend/view contracts.
Map every workspace section, tab, modal, action, table, form, script/AJAX workflow, and print/report section required for parity.
Identify all legacy views exceeding 500 lines and propose modular Blade decomposition boundaries so every resulting Blade file remains below 500 lines.
Confirm that the Drawing Hall workspace will mount exclusively inside <x-layouts.workspace-layout>.
Confirm that all four statutory print outputs will mount exclusively inside <x-layouts.report-layout>.
Inventory applicable existing <x-ui.*> components and map legacy UI elements to them, including cards, buttons, modals, tables, badges, tabs, inputs, selects, alerts, and icons where applicable.
Identify any legacy duplicated shell, CSS, modal, table, button, icon, or JavaScript infrastructure that must NOT be carried into CampusLynk.
Do not modify application files, Blade views, routes, controllers, models, migrations, tests, database state, or control-plane state.
Do not implement any part of M2.7.
Return a TASK_REPORT only, including recommended implementation slicing and any risks or ambiguities.
constraints: DO NOT modify any repository files.
DO NOT modify STATE.json or FEATURE_MATRIX.md.
DO NOT modify application code, Blade views, routes, controllers, models, migrations, or tests.
DO NOT execute database migrations or alter database state.
All four statutory print views must use <x-layouts.report-layout>.
Reuse existing <x-ui.*> components; no ad-hoc UI infrastructure may be proposed where an existing component applies.
All final Blade partials must remain strictly below 500 lines.
Legacy monolithic views must be decomposed rather than copied wholesale.
task_dispatch.expected_report: TASK_REPORT containing: legacy Drawing Hall workspace and four print files discovered; line counts and functional inventory; M2.6 backend/view contract mapping; workspace tabs/modals/actions/forms/tables/scripts; four statutory print-mode structures and shared sections; target shell/component mapping; proposed modular Blade decomposition with estimated file boundaries and line counts; duplicated legacy infrastructure identified for elimination; route/data dependencies; parity risks and ambiguities; recommended first implementation slice and subsequent slices.
stop_conditions: Stop after completing the read-only forensic analysis.
Do not implement or refactor any application code.
Do not change migration state or checkpoint state.
